ownerReport.subtitle: Owner statement
ownerReport.title: Owner financial report
ownerReport.intro: Operating performance of your portfolio for the period, in Moroccan dirham (MAD).
ownerReport.noteNet: Net profit is gross revenue (STR and LTR) minus commission, payroll, utilities and repairs.
ownerReport.noteSolo: Self-managed portfolio: no conciergerie commission applies.
ownerReport.noteOccupancy: STR occupancy is the share of short-term unit-nights that were booked.

common.ctaFallback: Button not working? Copy this link into your browser:
common.automated: This is an automated message from {{brand}}. Please do not reply to it.

invitation.subject: {{inviter}} invited you to {{brand}}
invitation.title: You're invited

intro.owner: {{inviter}} has invited you to follow your properties on {{brand}}: revenue, occupancy and net profit in one place.
intro.conciergerie: {{inviter}} has invited your conciergerie to manage their property on {{brand}}.
intro.tenant: {{inviter}} has invited you to {{brand}}, where you can see your lease and your rent invoices.

invitation.ignore: If you weren't expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

passwordReset.subject: Reset your {{brand}} password
passwordReset.preview: Choose a new password for your account
passwordReset.title: Reset your password
passwordReset.intro: We received a request to reset the password of your {{brand}} account. Choose a new one with the button below.
passwordReset.ignore: If you didn't ask for this, you can ignore this email. Your password won't change.

invoiceIssued.subject: Invoice {{number}} from {{brand}}
invoiceIssued.title: Your {{month}} invoice
invoiceIssued.intro: Your {{brand}} subscription invoice for {{month}} is ready. Please pay it by bank transfer before {{date}}.
invoiceIssued.proForma: This is a pro-forma invoice until our company registration details are on file.
invoiceIssued.terms: If we haven't received the payment 8 days after the invoice was issued, your account becomes read-only.

paymentReminder.subject: Reminder: invoice {{number}} is due on {{date}}
paymentReminder.title: Payment reminder
paymentReminder.intro: Invoice {{number}} for {{month}} ({{amount}}) is still unpaid. It is due on {{date}}.
paymentReminder.warning: If we haven't received your transfer by {{date}}, your account becomes read-only: you can still sign in and view everything, but you can't add or edit anything.
paymentReminder.alreadyPaid: Already paid? Thank you. A transfer can take a day or two to arrive, so there is nothing more to do.

accountReadOnly.subject: Your {{brand}} account is now read-only
accountReadOnly.title: Your account is read-only
accountReadOnly.intro: Invoice {{number}} ({{amount}}) was due on {{date}} and we haven't received the payment yet.
accountReadOnly.effect: You and your team can still sign in and view everything, but you can't add or edit anything until the invoice is paid. The owners and tenants linked to your account keep their access.
accountReadOnly.how: Pay by bank transfer with the details on the invoice. We restore full access as soon as the payment is registered.

paymentConfirmed.subject: Payment received for invoice {{number}}
paymentConfirmed.subjectRestored: Payment received: your {{brand}} access is restored
paymentConfirmed.title: Payment received
paymentConfirmed.intro: Thank you. We registered your payment of {{amount}} for invoice {{number}}.
paymentConfirmed.restored: Your account is active again: you and your team can add and edit as usual.

leaseRenewal.subject: Lease ending soon: {{tenant}} · {{unit}}
leaseRenewal.title: A lease is ending soon
leaseRenewal.intro: The lease of {{tenant}} for {{unit}} at {{property}} ends on {{date}}, {{relative}}.
leaseRenewal.hint: Renew it with a new end date and rent, or let it end.

rentInvoice.subject: Rent invoice {{number}} · {{month}}
rentInvoice.title: Your rent for {{month}}
rentInvoice.intro: {{issuer}} has issued your rent invoice for {{unit}}. Please pay it by bank transfer before {{date}}.
